views.notSavedRetry: The view wasn't saved. Try again.
views.saveBody: Its filters, sort and layout, under a name only you see.

person.found_one: {{count}} person found: press Enter to pick them.
person.found_other: {{count}} people found: use the arrow keys, then Enter.

power_on.label: Power on
power_on.message: Powers on the VMs that are off.

shutdown_guest.label: Shut down guest
shutdown_guest.message: Asks each guest OS to shut down, through VMware Tools.

power_off.label: Power off
power_off.message: Powers the VMs off without asking the guest OS: unsaved work is lost.

snapshot_create.label: Take a snapshot
snapshot_create.message: Takes a snapshot of each VM, without its memory.

delete.label: Delete
delete.message: Deletes the deployments, their VMs, IP addresses and DNS records. Production ones wait for approval.

bulk.warned: {{warning}} Run it on this deployment to go on.

actions.runsOnConfirm: {{action}} runs on {{target}} as soon as you confirm.
actions.needsApproval: Needs approval: {{reasons}}. It starts once approved.
actions.rulesFailed: The form's rules could not be worked out: {{error}}
actions.notLoaded: The actions could not be loaded

detail.inputsLead: What it was requested or last updated with, as passed to the blueprint and to AWX as extra_vars.

vms.none: No VMs yet. They appear here as soon as vCenter creates them.
vms.name: Name

security.tagsRemoved: Its tags for {{groups}} were removed in NSX, so the group's firewall rules no longer apply to it. Use Add to a security group to put it back.

placement.notYet: Placement is decided when the VM is cloned.

lease.thenTold: Then you are told; nothing is deleted.
lease.thenOff_one: Then its VMs are powered off, and deleted {{count}} day later.
lease.thenOff_other: Then its VMs are powered off, and deleted {{count}} days later.

lifetime.endedSoft_one: Its {{count}}-day lifetime ended on {{date}}: extending it warns you.
lifetime.endedSoft_other: Its {{count}}-day lifetime ended on {{date}}: extending it warns you.
lifetime.endsSoft_one: Its {{count}}-day lifetime ends on {{date}}: extending it warns you.
lifetime.endsSoft_other: Its {{count}}-day lifetime ends on {{date}}: extending it warns you.
lifetime.endedHard_one: Its {{count}}-day lifetime ended on {{date}}: extending it needs approval.
lifetime.endedHard_other: Its {{count}}-day lifetime ended on {{date}}: extending it needs approval.
lifetime.endsHard_one: Its {{count}}-day lifetime ends on {{date}}: extending it needs approval.
lifetime.endsHard_other: Its {{count}}-day lifetime ends on {{date}}: extending it needs approval.
lifetime.livesSoft_one: It lives {{count}} day at most, until {{date}}: {{left}} left. Extending it past that warns you.
lifetime.livesSoft_other: It lives {{count}} days at most, until {{date}}: {{left}} left. Extending it past that warns you.
lifetime.livesHard_one: It lives {{count}} day at most, until {{date}}: {{left}} left. Extending it past that needs approval.
lifetime.livesHard_other: It lives {{count}} days at most, until {{date}}: {{left}} left. Extending it past that needs approval.

lease.extensionsSoft: {{used}}. The lease policy is soft: going beyond warns you, and needs no approval.
lease.extensionsSoftUpTo_one: {{used}}; up to {{count}} day. The lease policy is soft: going beyond warns you, and needs no approval.
lease.extensionsSoftUpTo_other: {{used}}; up to {{count}} days. The lease policy is soft: going beyond warns you, and needs no approval.
lease.noExpiry: No expiry: the lease policy keeps it until someone deletes it.
lease.ended: The lease ended on {{date}} and its VMs were powered off.
lease.endedDeletes: The lease ended on {{date}} and its VMs were powered off. It is deleted on {{deletes}} unless you extend the lease.

tip.warns: A policy warns, and you may go on

drift.title: Changed outside rvav
drift.lead_one: This VM differs in vCenter from how rvav left it. Change it back in vCenter, or accept the changes.
drift.lead_other: These VMs differ in vCenter from how rvav left them. Change them back in vCenter, or accept the changes.
drift.take: Take the VM as it is in vCenter

history.none: No day-2 action has run on it yet.
history.noneCreatedBy: No day-2 action has run on it yet. <request>{{number}}</request> created it.

how.ssh_key: With the SSH key given for it
how.password: With the password given for it

access.notCopiedBody: Your browser refused: select the key and copy it, or save it.
access.saveNow: Save it now: rvav no longer has it.
access.once: rvav gives the private key once. As it shows it to you, it forgets it: no one, you included, can download it again.
access.where: Save it where only you can read it, such as <path>~/.ssh</path> or your password manager.
access.leaveBody: You haven't saved or copied it, and rvav no longer has it: once you close, no one can download it again.
access.onlyOwner: Only the deployment's owner, {{name}}, can download its private key.
access.madePair: rvav made a key pair for this deployment. You can download its private key once.
access.downloaded: {{name}} downloaded the private key <time/>. rvav no longer has it.
access.forgotten: rvav no longer has the private key: it was forgotten when the VMs were deleted.
access.title: Remote access
access.lead: The user you sign in to the VMs as

vm.noLink: No vSphere Client link yet: it needs the instance UUID of {{vcenter}}, which rvav reads at its next inventory sync.
vm.tagsNotRead: Not read yet: rvav reads them at its next inventory sync.
vm.noCustom: None: it was built without custom properties, or before rvav kept them.
vm.maskedNote: {{masked}} marks a property that reads a secret input: its value isn't kept.

console.noWmks: The console client did not load (no WMKS).
console.title: Console · {{name}}
console.notSetUp: The web console is not set up here: an administrator can set it up in Integrations › vCenter, with VMware's WebMKS SDK scripts. Open the console in VMware Remote Console instead; it needs VMRC installed and access to vCenter and the ESXi hosts.

topology.title: Topology
topology.lead: What the deployment holds, as rvav last read it from vCenter and NSX.
topology.empty: Nothing to draw: the deployment holds no VMs or NSX resources.
topology.label: Topology of {{name}}
topology.tagsDrifted: Its NSX tags changed outside rvav.

update.title: Update {{name}}
update.lead: Change its inputs, or move it to another version of the item. Review what changes before it runs.
update.notInPlace: These changes can't be made in place. Change them back, or delete the deployment and request it again.
update.unchanged: {{name}} already has this version and these inputs: change an input to update it.
update.changeBack: Change them back, or delete the deployment and request it again.
update.changeInput: Change an input to see what the update does.
update.nothingChanges: Nothing changes on the VMs: the deployment keeps the new inputs.
update.startsOnConfirm: The update starts as soon as you confirm it.
update.mayAnyway: You may update anyway: the request keeps the warning.
update.reasonPlaceholder: Why does it change? Add a ticket number if there is one.
update.secrets: rvav doesn't show the secret inputs: give them again.

confirm.title: Update {{name}}?
confirm.approval_one: It waits for approval, then makes this change.
confirm.approval_other: It waits for approval, then makes these {{count}} changes.

version.ownHint: Its own version: the update changes its inputs.
version.moveHint: Its inputs move to this version.

ad.title: Active Directory
ad.lead: Computer objects rvav made before the VMs were built
